correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustion reduced to one pencil. For any smooth pencil of symmetric forms Q,R, Q is invertible and A=Q^{-1}R has irreducible cubic characteristic polynomial, since a rational eigenvalue would give a singular pencil member. Identify the space with K=F125; self-adjointness for Q makes Q and R the trace pairings with coefficients c and cα, where α generates K. PGL2(F5) is regular on the 120 degree-three elements (a stabilizing fractional-linear map gives a relation of degree at most two); multiplying input by K* adjusts c up to F5*, because squaring is bijective in K*/F5* of order 31. Thus all smooth pencils are conjugate. A pencil stabilizer normalizes K: a pencil basis change replaces A by a fractional-linear function generating the same field. Such a stabilizer is semilinear, and for each of the three Frobenius powers there is exactly one projective multiplier carrying the resulting coefficient plane back to itself: K*/F5* acts regularly on the 31 coefficient planes, as a nonrational multiplier cannot preserve a proper nonzero subspace. Hence the pencil orbit has 372000/3=124000 elements. The independent exact replay /workspace/record1_pencil_certificate.py verifies all six forms in the common displayed pencil, tests the 156 quotient lines with 25 new members each, and finds exactly the two printed nets. It also recomputes their geometric rank-one ideals on the remaining charts and the two permutations of 31 rational points. The ideal for type A on u=1 is (v+w²−w+1,w³−w²+w+1); the cubic is irreducible and separable. Type B and both infinity charts are empty. Transitivity on pencils now gives one extension of each type everywhere, and counting 31 pencils per net gives 4000 nets in each orbit and stabilizer 93. This verifies the complete claim without rerunning the frozen full-size sweep.

evidence: In split coordinates over the algebraic closure the field form spans three independent squares, while the twisted-field form spans three cyclic mixed monomials and contains no rank-one square. Frobenius cycles the three square lines. On rational projective points the maps are powering by 2 and 6 on the order-31 quotient, both bijective.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For each normal form the source multipliers K*/F5* act regularly on its 31 pencils: the action on the output has exponent 2 or 6, hence is the full projective Singer group. The stabilizer of a pencil inside the net stabilizer has order at most 3 by the trace-pairing calculation, and the net contains the multiplier group and the order-three Frobenius normalizer, so the stabilizer has order 93. With transitivity on all smooth pencils each net orbit therefore contains exactly one extension of each pencil (4000×31/124000=1). These are straightforward consequences once the prior normal forms are applied, even if a printed source does not list the F5-specific numbers.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Polarize a net basis to a symmetric bilinear product B. All rational nonzero output functionals give nonsingular forms iff B(x,−) is onto for every x≠0: an output functional annihilates the image exactly when x is in the radical of its form. Changing source coordinates and net basis is exactly strong isotopy (same linear change in both inputs, arbitrary linear output). There is no scalar or basis mismatch at the projective orbit level. The two normal forms over F125 are x² and x^6; x^26 is obtained from x^6 by output Frobenius squared. Thus the prior classification is on the actual objects up to the actual equivalence.
